# Skrell
Skrell are an amphibious species, that come from the planet Jargon 4, a humid planet filled with swamps and archipelagos. Skrell are herbivores and opulent in nature thanks to central tenets of the Skrellian religion.
While classically preferring diplomacy, the Skrell participate in the largest military alliance in the galaxy, the Solar-Central Compact.
Skrell have a small pocket in their head that can store a singular item.
Skrell are amphibious, and possess the ability to breathe underwater.
Skrell livers are highly sensitive - anything that could get you drunk will do so with [color=#1e90ff]+400%[/color] effectiveness.
Skrell sometimes possess a delicate tail. This tail is not dextrous enough to pull or lift items.
